note: Keywords Twin SEO checks your position for. Edit this on the Rankings card in the app — your edits are saved to .data/keywords.json and this bundled file is only the starting point. Geo terms are built by putting each city into each template, so 97 cities x 3 templates is 291 checks without typing them out.

groups.label: Core intent
groups.why: The head terms every cash buyer competes for. High volume, high competition, and the ones that decide whether you exist in this market at all.
terms: companies that buy houses for cash
sell my house without a realtor

groups.label: Bay Area
groups.why: Regional terms sit between the head terms and the city pages. Cheaper to win than the national head terms, and they feed every city page below.
terms: sell my house fast bay area
sell my house fast san francisco bay area

groups.label: Seller situation
groups.why: Lower volume, far less competition, and the highest intent of anything here. Someone searching these has a problem your offer solves today. These are usually the cheapest wins on the list.
terms: sell house as is no repairs
sell house out of state owner
sell house after death of owner

groups.label: Questions
groups.why: What people search before they are ready to call. Winning these puts you in the answer box and in the AI assistants, which is what the AI readiness scan measures.
terms: how to sell my house fast
how to sell a house without a realtor
how much do cash home buyers pay
how fast can you sell a house for cash
what is a cash offer on a house
do cash buyers pay closing costs
is selling to a cash buyer a good idea
how long does a cash home sale take
cash offer vs listing with a realtor

groups.label: Brand
groups.why: Your own name. If these are not first, something is wrong that no amount of other work will fix.
